> 第1章 我不想娶你1（第1页）

遇见韩经年的那一天，夏晚安心底只有三个字：一辈子。他是她一眼，就认定的、想要的一辈子。——《好想住你隔壁》叶非夜-偌大敞亮的办公室里，夏晚安盯着坐在办公桌前韩经年等了会儿，见他看到自己来，还没停下手头工作的意思，便主动出了声：“我……我来找你，是有事要跟你说。”韩经年敲键盘的指尖，停了停，但他没看她，开口的声音平又冷：“你说。”这样疏离又冷漠的他，让夏晚安一下子不敢开口了，她沉默了良久，见韩经年疑惑地抬头看向了自己，这才鼓着勇气说：“我……我想说，我可以嫁给你。”韩经年愣住，不过短短的一刹那，他就恢复了一贯的沉静和冷漠：“我不想娶你。”简单的五个字，让夏晚安的指尖，下意识的揪紧了衣衫，她似是怕被他看出什么一般，没过多的迟疑，很快就说了话：“我……我知道的……我知道你不喜欢我，也不想娶我……但是，他们让我们联姻……”夏晚安说到这里，不知道该怎么说下去了，她纠结了好一会儿，终究还是不愿意就这般放弃，又动着唇，换了一种说法：“……你放心，我们就是交易，我们结婚后，我保证不会影响你现在的生活，而你要的合作，我会让我爸爸促成……我，我不喜欢你的，我这样做，没别的意思，就是，就是为了，为了让我爸爸开心……所以，你，你再……”夏晚安后面的话还没说完，韩经年就出了声，声线勾人，声音清冷：“我要开会了，你自便。”说着，他就起身，拿了桌子上的一份文件。夏晚安张了张口，还想再说点什么去劝韩经年，只是后面的话，一个字都没说出口，韩经年当她不存在般，丢下她一个人，离开了。随着办公室厚重的门关上，夏晚安才将视线从韩经年离开的方向收了回来。她环顾了一圈他的办公室，最后视线落在了他的办公桌前。她盯着他刚刚坐过的地方，眉眼泛起了一抹温软，不过很快，就被淡淡的哀伤掩盖过了。她就知道，他不喜欢她，不会娶她的，可她还是不死心的来试探………韩经年散会，再回到办公室，已是两个小时后。他一边往办公桌前走，一边对着跟在自己身后的秘书讲着话，等他坐在办公椅上时，他要说的话，才算说完，而秘书也总算可以开口说自己想说的话：“韩总，夏小姐在两个小时前已经离开了……”面对这句话，韩经年脸上的神情，没有任何的波动。秘书只好继续往下说：“我有说让司机送她，但夏小姐拒绝了。”韩经年还是那副漫不经心的模样，仿佛秘书是空气一般。“这是陈律师让我转交给您的文件。”秘书第三次开了口，并且递上了一份文档。韩经年终于有了反应，他微点了一下头，就麻利的拆开了文档，在看到里面的内容后，他的眉心蓦的蹙起。“韩总？”秘书见韩经年迟迟没反应，又开了口。韩经年回神，冲着秘书看了一眼。“没什么事的话，我就先下去了。”韩经年“嗯”了一声，等秘书退开一段距离后，再次看向了手中的那份文档。看着看着，他似是很焦躁般，将那份文档直接丢进了抽屉里，然后打开电脑，投入工作。可他敲打着键盘的动作，泄露了他的不专心。这样的状态，持续了大概一个小时，他再次拉开了抽屉，拿出了那份文档，然后他就靠在办公椅上，抬头看向了天花板。他一个人，静静的呆了许久，最后还是拿起了手机，拨通了夏晚安的电话。很快，电话被接听了。不知道是不是他的错觉，电话那端的夏晚安，声音有点惊喜又有点胆怯：“喂？”韩经年并没有在夏晚安的语气中考虑太久，就直接开口，说了自己要说的重点：“我可以娶你。”

> Chapter 1 I don’t want to marry you 1 (Page 1)
The day she met Han Jingnian, Xia Wan'an had only three words in her heart: forever. He was the one she recognized at one glance and wanted for the rest of her life. ——"I Want to Live Next Door to You" Ye Feiye - In the large and bright office, Xia Wan'an stared at Han Jingnian sitting at the desk and waited for a while. Seeing that he had not stopped what he was doing when he saw her coming, he took the initiative to say: "I...I came to you because I have something to tell you." Han Jingnian paused while typing the keyboard with his fingertips, but he did not look at her. He spoke in a calm and cold voice: "You tell me." Such a distant and indifferent person made him feel uncomfortable. Xia Wan'an didn't dare to speak for a while. She was silent for a long time. When she saw Han Jingnian looking up at her in confusion, she mustered up the courage to say: "I... I want to say that I can marry you." Han Jingnian was stunned, but in a short moment, he returned to his usual calmness and indifference: "I don't want to marry you." These five simple words made Xia Wan'an's fingertips subconsciously tighten her clothes, as if she was afraid of being noticed by him. Without too much hesitation, he spoke quickly: "I... I know... I know you don't like me and don't want to marry me... But, they asked us to get married..." After Xia Wan'an said this, she didn't know how to continue. She struggled for a while, but she was still unwilling to give up like this. She moved her lips again and said in a different way: "... Don't worry, we are a deal. After we get married, I promise it will not affect it. Your current life, and the cooperation you want, I will ask my father to facilitate... I, I don't like you, I do this for no other reason, just to make my father happy... So, you, if you..." Before Xia Wan'an finished speaking, Han Jingnian spoke up, his voice was seductive and cold: "I have a meeting, you can do it yourself." After that, he stood up and took a document on the table. Xia Wan'an opened her mouth, wanting to say something more to persuade Han Jingnian, but she didn't say a word of the rest. Han Jingnian left her alone as if she didn't exist. As the heavy door of the office closed, Xia Wan'an looked away from the direction Han Jingnian left. She looked around his office, and finally her eyes fell on his desk. She stared at the place where he had just sat, a touch of warmth appeared in her eyebrows, but it was soon covered up by a touch of sadness. She knew that he didn't like her and wouldn't marry her, but she still didn't give up and came to test... Han Jingnian ended the meeting and returned to the office two hours later. As he walked to his desk, he spoke to the secretary who was following him. When he sat on the office chair, what he wanted to say was finally finished, and the secretary could finally say what he wanted to say: "Mr. Han, Miss Xia left two hours ago..." Faced with this sentence, the expression on Han Jingnian's face showed no fluctuation. The secretary had no choice but to continue: "I asked the driver to take her off, but Miss Xia refused." Han Jingnian still looked nonchalant, as if the secretary was nothing but air. "This is the document that Lawyer Chen asked me to forward to you." The secretary spoke for the third time and handed over a document. Han Jingnian finally reacted. He nodded slightly and quickly opened the document. After seeing the contents inside, his eyebrows suddenly furrowed. "Mr. Han?" Seeing Han Jingnian's delay in responding, the secretary spoke again. Han Jingnian came to his senses and glanced at his secretary. "If there's nothing else, I'll go down first." Han Jingnian said "hmm", and after the secretary stepped back a distance, he looked at the document in his hand again. Looking at it, he seemed to be very anxious and threw the document directly into the drawer, then turned on the computer and got into work. But the way he tapped the keyboard betrayed his inattention. This state lasted for about an hour. He opened the drawer again and took out the document. Then he leaned on the office chair and looked up at the ceiling. He stayed alone for a long time, and finally picked up the phone and dialed Xia Good Night. Soon, the call was answered. I don't know if it was his imagination, but Xia Wan'an's voice on the other end of the phone was a little surprised and a little timid: "Hello?" Han Jingnian didn't think about Xia Wan'an's tone for too long, and he spoke directly and said the key point of what he wanted to say: "I can marry you."
